figma.note: Hi-res masters + vector silhouette masks for G/H/I. Export polys/SVG; rasterize locally for true alpha.

hardRules: Stack layout = house floorplan / puzzle (rooms BESIDE each other). Never a vertical tower of slabs.
Phase 2 cutouts = AI Solo rooms OR Figma-masked master slices (user choice). Always true-alpha PNGs (corners alpha 0).
NEVER ship Figma MCP PNG exports as final cutouts — they flatten mask transparency to opaque gray. Rasterize polygon masks onto the master locally.
Void clear = edge-connected charcoal only. Do NOT globally knock all dark pixels (that eats inbound walls).

Phase 3 = Figma-like place editor: selection bbox with 8 resize handles + rotate handle (Shift+resize = aspect lock, Shift+rotate = 15° snap), Shift multi-select, layer icons, Flip H / Flip V for any selected piece (rooms + connectors; persist flipX/flipY), Lock = production places.json. No discrete free-rotate icon buttons — use bbox rotate + flips for iso connectors.

Unlock-only connector tray (bottom-left): catalog in assets/connectors/catalog.json. Hover = preview, drag onto stage (or +) places centered/at drop with selection+bbox active. − / Delete removes selected connectors only.
This Stack HTML is the reusable base layout for other projects — swap cutout/connector art + prompts; keep chrome, phases, place editor, connector tray.
Locked places download as places-{g|h|i}.json; agent writes that file into assets/cutouts/{cand}/places.json.
Draft placements autosave to localStorage key iso-stage-cutout.placeEditor.v1 — Lock is the production gate.
While locked: Solo-quality hover lift+tint. While unlocked: drag/layer + connector tray (no hover lift).
Zero padding inside the place frame. Stage aspect from places masterWidth/masterHeight.

shared.positive: Ultra high-resolution crisp isometric digi-twin, soft studio lighting, pure flat solid #0a0c10 charcoal void, no text, no labels, no UI, no dashed boxes, no watermark, sharp edges for zoom, expanded open props, ONE shared camera and ONE lighting setup across the whole facility
shared.negative: vertical tower of three identical platforms, platforms stacked straight up like a list, large empty gaps between floors, exploded diagram with air between slabs, cutouts pasted one above another, odd mid-room crop, collage of separate renders, misaligned cameras per room, regenerated rooms that do not match a master crop, UI chrome, captions, watermarks, blurry, low-res

type.positive: ONE continuous facility laid out like rooms in a house / interlocking puzzle — platforms sit BESIDE each other (L-shape, courtyard, or staggered cluster), NOT in a vertical column. One or two complete rooms per platform. Slight careful overlap only where pieces share a wall or corner (puzzle tabs). Each room fully readable if isolated. Soft contact shadows. Digi-twin floorplan, not a skyscraper stack.
type.negative: vertical list stack, three platforms centered one above the other, big vertical air bands, mid-room crops that destroy meaning, heavy pasted overlap, ladder of identical slabs, independent dioramas composited after the fact

efficiency: Phase 2 = AI Solo cutouts (hover feel) or Figma-masked master slices (fidelity)
Phase 3 = place editor → Lock → production places.json
Agent commits locked places-{cand}.json into assets/cutouts/{cand}/places.json
Figma path when seams need masks: polys → figma_mask_rasterize.py (never trust Figma PNG alpha)
pipeline: Phase 1: 3 floorplan masters; user pick; upscale ≥2880
Phase 2: true-alpha room cutouts (AI Solo or Figma-masked) into cutouts/{g,h,i}/
Phase 3: place editor — drag, layer, Lock downloads production places; hover tint only while locked

phase2.forbidden: Do not ship Figma MCP PNG exports (opaque gray). Do not leave opaque charcoal/gray boxes. Do not globally knock dark walls.
phase2.positive: True-alpha room PNGs (inbound/ops/make). AI Solo for working preview; Figma masks when master fidelity is required.
phase2.negative: Figma-flattened gray boxes, untrimmed empty alpha boxes, UI labels

phase3.positive: Figma-like transform box on selection: 8 resize handles + rotation handle (free angle; Shift snaps 15°; Shift+resize locks ratio). Shift+click multi-select. Toolbar icons only (layer/lock/download/reset) with tooltips — no rotate icon buttons. places include width/height/rotate. Lock = production JSON + hover tint. Draft: iso-stage-cutout.placeEditor.v1
